Hey Hi there! I got started with programming in my freshman year at MallaReddy Engineering College, where I completed my Bachelor's in Computer Science and Engineering (2019–2023) with a CGPA of 8.53.

I then earned my Master's in Computer Science from George Mason University, Fairfax (2023–2025), with a GPA of 3.77.

Today I build production software across Generative AI, cloud, and full-stack development: agentic assistants on Anthropic Claude, RAG pipelines with vector search, microservices on AWS, and data and automation tools for healthcare operations.
